answer: Each identity must post a bonded stake and be countersigned by independent peers on separate hardware before its work counts, so a sybil farm's clones all trace to one attestation root and their votes collapse into a single harbor of weight. Attacker cost: a fresh device attestation, a paid bond and real compute per identity, plus losing every bond once one shared signal exposes the cluster - a juniper grown from one root, not a thousand.
